headline: Explosions heard in Riyadh as Saudi Arabia sounds sirens for the first time after Houthis escalate attacks on oil facilities and naval blockade
summary: Explosions were heard and air raid warnings sounded across Riyadh, the first alert since the Houthis declared a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia. The group has escalated attacks on oil facilities.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude oil exporter through state-owned Saudi Aramco, so attacks on its facilities and shipping routes can disrupt global oil supply.
why_moved: Houthi attacks on oil facilities and a declared naval blockade raise the risk of disruption to Saudi crude output and exports.
